summary: Tested Valuation Studio backend (9 pytest cases, 8 passed) and frontend (home/company/watchlist navigation). Custom ratio math (POC, POV, Ratio Compra, Ratio Venta) verified against known inputs and matches exact formula (POC=297, POV=371.25, RC=197%, RV=271.25%). AAPL ($309.70), SAP.DE (European) both return valid data with custom_ratios populated. _id is correctly excluded from all responses. Cache works. Frontend renders Spanish UI, hero KPIs, editable inputs, recalc, search dropdown, watchlist nav all functional.

minor.issue: Invalid tickers (e.g. INVALIDTICKERZZZZ) return HTTP 200 with all-null fields instead of 404. yfinance returns a partial info dict with defaults; current check `if not info: raise ValueError(...)` doesn't fire because info is non-empty after fast_info branch. Suggested fix: after fetch, raise ValueError if `current_price is None and market_cap is None and not info.get('symbol')` (i.e., no usable data).

action_items: Fix /api/company/{ticker} to return 404 when yfinance has no usable data (currently leaks an empty payload with HTTP 200).
Optional: HEAD-style probe or 'symbol' field check before fallback fast_info path to short-circuit invalid tickers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~525 lines and still single-file; acceptable for v1 but consider splitting helpers (fetch_fundamentals_sync, compute_custom_ratios) into a services module.
Cache invalidation: TTL is 6h but `refresh=true` flag works; consider adding cache TTL constant via env.
compute_custom_ratios: divides by shares/mcap/price without explicit ZeroDivisionError handling beyond <=0 check - currently fine.
fetch_fundamentals_sync swallows many exceptions silently (info, financials, cashflow). Logging only at INFO/WARNING. OK for v1 but makes debugging hard.
No rate limiting on /api/company/*; yfinance could rate-limit upstream. Cache mitigates this.
seed_data_creation: None - uses live yfinance data. MongoDB caches AAPL, MSFT, SAP.DE fundamentals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_valuation.py. Math test_calculate_math validates exact formula with deterministic inputs. Only known issue: invalid ticker handling. Frontend works fully - Spanish UI, AAPL page shows Ratio Compra -26.8%, Ratio Venta -3.1% (negative=overvalued, expected). data-testids in place: search-input, search-submit, ratio-compra-value, ratio-venta-value, input-revenue_2y, recalc-button, watchlist-toggle.
rca of the issue: Invalid ticker 404: yfinance's `t.info` returns a dict with some default null fields rather than empty for unknown tickers. The guard `if not info: raise ValueError(...)` only catches empty dict case. Need to also check that critical fields (currentPrice OR marketCap OR symbol) are present before considering data valid.
